operations.title: Operations
operations.lead: Define the operations your company uses on work cards — transport, marking, field work, and more.
operations.empty: No operations yet. Create transport, road marking, or other work types your team uses.
operations.name: Name
operations.codeHelper: Leave blank to auto-generate from the name (works with Bulgarian names too).
operations.normsHelper: Numbers only — e.g. {rate} {inputUnit} per {basis} {outputUnit}. Not free text like "paint per m2".
operations.transportNormsHelper: Numbers only — L/100 km empty + L/t (e.g. 25 + 0.4). On the task: km + fuel start/end + receipts. Do not ask workers to invent liters used.
operations.laborNormsHelper: Preset hours for this labor-only operation. Task lines can override later.
operations.materialUnitOverride: Override only if the master unit is missing:
operations.noMaterialsSelected: No SKUs selected yet. Search and tap to multi-select fuel, paint, bitumen…
operations.materialsEmptyImport: Import an invoice to add materials.
operations.materialNormBasisHelper: Which rate is used for expected calc. Switching does not clear the other pair. Paint → m²; fuel → working hour.
operations.materialNormCardHint: Two independent norms — m² and hour rates stay separate when you switch basis. Unit comes from the warehouse material.
operations.normInputUnitLabeled: Input unit (e.g. L) — rate applies per {outputUnit}
operations.deleteConfirm: This permanently removes the operation. Blocked if it is used on any task — deactivate instead.
operations.deleteBlockedInUse: Cannot delete this operation because it is used on one or more tasks. Deactivate it instead.

wizard.stepBasicsHint: Name the operation and choose its kind (filters units & norms).
wizard.stepOutputHint: Multi-select what the worker reports on this operation (m², hours, km, liters…). Selecting several is allowed.
wizard.stepNormsHint: Numbers only: rate and per-output qty (e.g. 0.5 L per 1 m²). Not free text. Pick the SKU on the next step.
wizard.stepMaterialsHint: Same Operation: labor-only OR labor + materials (toggle). Multi-select default SKUs when on. Leftovers are entered on the task after warehouse issue.
wizard.stepMaterialsNormsHint: Toggle labor-only vs labor + materials. Each SKU has its own basis — paint per m² and fuel per working hour can both be set on the same operation.
wizard.materialsNormsCoupledHint: Off = labor-only. On = add separate SKU lines (e.g. paint per m² AND machine fuel per working hour). Fuel norms are for expected calc from task hours/km — workers do not enter fuel hours on every operation.
wizard.dualMaterialSlotsHint: Add lines as needed: (1) paint/thinner → rate per m², (2) optional fuel → rate per working hour or per km. Workers report m² per op; hours/km once on the task.
wizard.stepReviewHint: Check report units, time norm, rates, and materials, then save.
wizard.outputUnitHelper: Prefer m² (or km) on the operation. Working hours once on the task. Do not pick L here for paint leftovers — leftovers go on Materials.
wizard.outputUnitHelperTransport: Prefer km (+ optional hours). Fuel litres come from tank start/end + receipts on the task — not as the main report chip.
wizard.plannedHoursHelper: Optional planned hours when hours are not selected as a report unit. Material fuel norms can use reported working hours.
wizard.laborNoMaterials: Labor-only operations do not consume warehouse materials.
wizard.materialsLinesLater: Issue material lines on the task from warehouse. Workers enter leftover (остатък) on End — consumed = issued − leftover.
wizard.normsMaterialsHint: Pick paint/fuel SKU on the next step; here only the rate.

examples.warehouse_task: Example: warehouse move → worker reports loads or pieces.
examples.inspection: Example: inspection → worker reports count or hours.
examples.workshop_service: Example: workshop job → worker reports hours.
examples.other: Pick a kind to suggest the right report units and norms.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.lead: Documents: import invoices. Materials: on-stock quantities. Locations: bins for issue.
warehouse.empty: No locations yet. Add paint rooms, fuel tanks, or yard bins.
warehouse.nextSliceNote: Issue materials from a location onto a task; workers enter leftovers on End (consumed = issued − leftover).
warehouse.name: Name
warehouse.qrHelper: Used on the printable door stamp. Leave blank to use ORGLOC:{id}.

intake.lead: Import a supplier invoice or proforma PDF. Review proposed lines, then Confirm to add SKUs to warehouse stock. Or add a material manually without an invoice.
intake.documentsLead: Import supplier invoices. Open a document for full detail + PDF. Confirm stores stock at a chosen location.
intake.materialsLead: On-stock materials from confirmed imports. Issuing materials to a task will decrease quantity here (next slice).
intake.uploaded: Imported — {count} proposed line(s). Review and confirm.
intake.lineRequired: Enter a material name or part number.
intake.confirmed: Confirmed — materials are in warehouse stock (SKU + on-stock qty).
intake.confirmHint: Pick a location, then Confirm. Writes each line as a warehouse SKU and adds quantity on stock. Original invoice is kept permanently.
intake.confirmWrites: Wrote SKU + on-stock quantity for each confirmed line.
intake.confirmAllBody: Writes {count} SKU(s) to warehouse and adds quantities on stock. Original invoice stays permanently.
intake.confirmRowBody: Creates/updates the SKU and adds this quantity to on-stock quantity.
intake.deleteLineBody: This removes the draft line only.
intake.noParsedLines: No lines parsed from this PDF. Add materials manually below, then Confirm.
intake.tableHint: Edit fields, pick unit, Save row, then Confirm row or Confirm all.
intake.searchMaterials: Search by name or material # / SKU
intake.searchEmpty: Nothing matched “{query}”. Try another name or SKU.
intake.docsEmpty: Import a supplier invoice PDF to review lines and add stock.
intake.empty: Import an invoice or add a material manually.
intake.locationRequired: Select a warehouse location before confirming into stock.
intake.noLocations: Add a location under Locations (e.g. Baza / Port 1) before confirming.
intake.legalBody: Fill legal name, VAT/EIK and registered address in Organization → Company details before confirming stock.
intake.legalRequired: Complete organization legal entity (name, VAT/EIK, address) before confirming.
intake.deleteDraftBody: This removes the unfinished import and its lines. Stock is unchanged. Confirmed invoices are never deleted.
intake.vatMismatch: Invoice buyer VAT does not match this organization. / ДДС номерът на купувача във фактурата не съвпада с тази организация.

legal.lead: Legal entity for invoices and warehouse buyer-VAT checks. Separate from your personal Profile nickname.
legal.savedComplete: Company details saved — ready for invoicing and warehouse confirm.
legal.savedIncomplete: Saved. Still missing required legal fields.
legal.incomplete: Legal entity incomplete — required for Confirm
legal.vatRegisteredHint: When off, company ID (EIK) is used instead of VAT.

tasks.listLead: Create multi-operation work cards and track status for your team.
tasks.workerListLead: Open a task to start, fill operations, upload docs, and end work.
tasks.listEmpty: No tasks yet. Create the first work card.
tasks.createLead: Create a multi-step work card. Workers tap Start and End themselves.
tasks.title: Title
tasks.projectOptionalTransportHint: Not required for one-time transport requests. Use “No project” and fill contract/request below.
tasks.scheduledEndDateHint: Leave blank for a single day
tasks.scheduledEndDateHelper: Optional. Use when one work card spans multiple days (e.g. 1–20 Aug) instead of creating many tasks.
tasks.endDateBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date.
tasks.endTimeBeforeStart: End time must be on or after the start time when on the same day.
tasks.plannedHoursOnShipmentsHint: Loading/unloading hours belong on each shipment above. Task-level start/end time is optional.
tasks.materialsHint: Warehouse issues materials onto this task. Enter leftover after work — consumed = issued − leftover.
tasks.depotRefuelHint: Issue fuel (or AdBlue / freon) from base in litres. Driver confirms received litres before it counts on the truck.
tasks.depotRefuelEmpty: No fuel SKUs in warehouse yet. Add diesel/fuel stock, then issue here.
tasks.depotIssueQtyHelper: Enter liters as a number. “Fill to full” is not supported yet.
tasks.depotQtyNumericRequired: Enter liters as a number (e.g. 400). Text like “to full” is not accepted yet.
tasks.startWizardHint: Enter starting odometer and fuel in tank, then start.
tasks.endWizardHint: Enter ending odometer and fuel in tank. Km is calculated from start/end when possible.
tasks.fuelDriverFlowHint: Driver: Start (km + fuel) → mid-trip receipt photos → End (km + fuel). Expand below only to correct paper values.
tasks.driverDayActiveHint: Add a receipt photo when you refuel. Tap “I’m at this stop” when you arrive. End when the trip is done.
tasks.driverDayDoneHint: Start/end readings are saved. Ask the office if something needs correcting.
tasks.depotConfirmHint: Warehouse poured {qty} L. Confirm what you received (dashboard).
tasks.fuelEquationHint: Burn = start + confirmed depot + road receipts − end. Compare to norm.
tasks.materialsNotUsedTransport: Warehouse materials are not used on transport tasks. Fuel = tank start/end + receipt photos.
tasks.materialsEmpty: No materials yet. Ask warehouse to issue materials for this task.
tasks.materialsAskWarehouse: Ask warehouse to issue materials for this task.
tasks.materialsOpNone: This operation consumes materials but has no default SKUs yet.
tasks.issueFromWarehouseHint: Default list = materials from this task’s operations. Fuel ~qty uses task machine hours / total km (and paint uses op m²). Edit qty before issuing.
tasks.issueOpMaterialsEmpty: No default materials on the operations of this task. Pick operations with materials, or use Add extra material.
tasks.extraMaterialsEmpty: No other warehouse SKUs match. Import stock or clear the search.
tasks.plannedIssueHours: Planned working hours (for fuel norms) — or fill Task totals above
tasks.deleteConfirm: This permanently removes the task. Blocked if finished or materials were already issued.
tasks.deleteBlockedCompleted: Cannot delete a completed task. Finished tasks are kept for history.
tasks.deleteBlockedMaterials: Cannot delete this task because materials were already issued or consumed. Finish the task and enter leftovers instead.
tasks.expensesHint: Photograph receipts, or add an expense manually (description + amount with VAT).
tasks.expensesHintTransport: Photograph касови бележки, or add manually without a receipt. Tank start/end + confirmed depot + photos → burn.
tasks.expensePhotosOnly: Add receipt photos (camera / gallery / PDF), or enter an expense without a receipt.
tasks.expenseManualRequired: Enter a description and/or amount (with VAT).
tasks.expensePhotoRequired: Add at least one receipt photo.
tasks.fuelTankHint: Start + confirmed depot + road receipts − end. System computes burn vs norm.
tasks.fuelEffectiveVsNorm: Effective {effective} L/100 km vs norm {expected} L/100 (expected {expectedL} L)
tasks.fuelSummaryIncomplete: Enter start, end, and km to see L/100 vs norm.
tasks.outboundLoadsHint: One stop per load address. Drivers can open each in Maps.
tasks.returnLoadsHint: Reverse / return cargo on the same trip (обратни товари).
tasks.shipmentsHint: Each shipment has a loading side, unloading side, and cargo description.
tasks.returnShipmentsHint: Reverse / return cargo on the same trip (обратни товари).
tasks.driverRouteHint: All pickups first, then all deliveries.
tasks.driverRouteHintFull: Outbound loadings → unloadings, then return loadings → unloadings. One Maps link for the full trip.
tasks.vehicleOverlapBody: This vehicle is on another open task with overlapping dates.
tasks.vehicleOverlapBodyPlates: Vehicle {plates} is already on another open task.
tasks.vehicleOverlapRetry: Override enabled — tap Create again to confirm.
tasks.assigneeOverlapBody: This person is already on another open task with overlapping dates.
tasks.assigneeOverlapRetry: Override enabled — tap Create again to confirm.
tasks.vehiclesHelper: Select up to {max} vehicles (e.g. trucks + machines).
tasks.searchToNarrow: Showing {max}. Type to narrow the list.
tasks.overallPeopleHelper: Select up to {max} people for the whole task.
tasks.operationsHelper: Pick one or more company operations. Optionally assign people to each step.
tasks.noOperations: No active operations yet. Create them under Operations first.
tasks.confirmSeenBanner: Please confirm you have seen this task before you can start.
tasks.confirmSeenDone: You confirmed you have seen this task
tasks.confirmSeenRequired: Confirm you've seen this task before starting.
tasks.scheduleSaved: Schedule updated. Workers must confirm again.
tasks.actualsHint: Per operation: paint/output only (e.g. m²). Machine hours, total km, and road fuel receipt are entered once for the whole task below.
tasks.leftoverHint: Leftover (остатък) per issued material. Consumed = issued − leftover. Issue materials on the Materials section first.
tasks.leftoverNoSkus: No default SKUs on this operation yet — leftovers will appear once materials are issued.

wizard.stepProjectHint: Link a project or create this {noun} without one.
wizard.stepProjectHintTransport: Project is optional. Many transport jobs are one-time contracts / requests — pick “No project” and add a contract/request number.
wizard.stepWhenHint: Schedule date and planned start for reminders. Workers tap Start/End themselves.
wizard.stepWhenHintTransport: Set the work-card date range. Put loading/unloading hours on each shipment — not on a generic time grid.
wizard.stepVehicleHint: Select one or more fleet vehicles. Filter by readiness and type. Warnings show when not ready.
wizard.stepPeopleHint: Search and assign people for the whole task.
wizard.stepOperationsHint: Pick distinct operations. Add people and notes per step.
wizard.stepOperationsHintMixed: Pick one or more operations. You can mix transport + marking on the same work card; assign people per operation.
wizard.stepShipmentsHint: Because you selected a transport operation — add load/unload addresses, cargo, and route (пратки).
wizard.stepReviewHint: Confirm and create. You will go to the tasks list.
wizard.leadTransport: Transport-style task (наряд / пътен лист). Workers start and end themselves.
wizard.leadConstruction: Site-style task (обект). Workers start and end themselves.

tasks.templatesHint: Pre-selects operations — you can still add or remove any ops below.
tasks.opsMixedHint: Example: transport op (haul machine) + road marking op (m² + hours) on the same work card.
tasks.opsTransportSelectedHint: Transport operation selected — next step asks for shipments (пратки).
tasks.opsNoTransportHint: No transport op yet — shipments step is skipped for marking/field-only cards.
tasks.projectOptionalAnyHint: Optional. One-time jobs can use “No project” plus a contract/request number.
tasks.shipmentsLaterHint: Shipments (пратки) appear after you select a transport operation.
tasks.startWizardHintRequired: Enter starting odometer and fuel in tank, then start. These lock after save.
tasks.startReadingsLockedHint: Odometer and fuel at start are locked after save. Ask the office to correct them.
tasks.noStopsYet: No stops on this task yet.
tasks.taskTotalsHint: Enter machine hour-meter readings (previous → current) and/or total km once for the whole work card — not per marking operation. Per-op fields are for m² and similar outputs only.
tasks.taskTotalsHintTransport: Report km (and optional hours) once on the work card. Fuel = tank start/end + receipts — not a free liters guess.
tasks.taskHourMeterHint: Enter previous and current machine hour-meter readings once for the whole task (not per marking). Hours worked = current − previous.
tasks.opUsesTaskTotals: Hours / km for this operation use the task totals below.
